desc: **Task A (math/derivation):** answer = Σ_d S_d·G_d with G_d = Σ_{k=0}^{N−1} k!(N−1−k)!·[x^k](F(x)/(1+10^d x)), F(x)=Π_d(1+10^d x)^{c_d} — verified on N=1 and N=3 (→1332).

**Task C' (main implementation):** Single-file solution using the O(mN) ODE coefficient recurrence for F (F'Q = FR), padded arrays + exec-compiled inner expression, exact synthetic division per digit-length class, weighted sum with w[k]=k!(N−1−k)!.

**Task E (testing & validation):** Hand-traced N=1 (→1), N=3 (F=(1+10x)^3, g=(1,20,100), w=(2,1,2), G₁=222, 6·222=1332 ✓); index/offset audit of fa/dfa padding, inv table, digit-class boundaries (e.g. N=10 → c₁=9, c₂=1, Σc_d=N), and loop bounds all consistent; complexity ≈ 2·10⁵ recurrence steps + ≤1.2·10⁶ division-loop steps, well within limits for N=2·10⁵.
**Task F (perf fallback):** Not needed — pure-Python loop counts are small enough; Kronecker/NTT path unnecessary.
